sn35.132:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā mahākaccāno avantīsu viharati makkarakaṭe araññakuṭikāyaṃ.
sn35.132:1.2: atha kho lohiccassa brāhmaṇassa sambahulā antevāsikā kaṭṭhahārakā māṇavakā yenāyasmato mahākaccānassa araññakuṭikā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā parito parito kuṭikāyaṃ anucaṅkamanti anuvicaranti uccāsaddā mahāsaddā kānici kānici seleyyakāni karonti
sn35.132:1.3: ime pana muṇḍakā samaṇakā ibbhā kaṇhā bandhupādāpaccā imesaṃ bhāratakānaṃ sakkatā garukatā mānitā pūjitā apacitāti.
sn35.132:1.4: atha kho āyasmā mahākaccāno vihārā nikkhamitvā te māṇavake etadavoca
sn35.132:1.7: evaṃ vutte te māṇavakā tuṇhī ahesuṃ.
sn35.132:1.8: atha kho āyasmā mahākaccāno te māṇavake gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi
sn35.132:8.1: atha kho te māṇavakā kupitā anattamanā yena lohicco brāhmaṇo tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā lohiccaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavocuṃ
sn35.132:8.2: yagghe bhavaṃ jāneyya samaṇo mahākaccāno brāhmaṇānaṃ mante ekaṃsena asaṃvadati paṭikkosatīti.
sn35.132:8.3: evaṃ vutte lohicco brāhmaṇo kupito ahosi anattamano.
sn35.132:8.5: na kho pana metaṃ paṭirūpaṃ yohaṃ aññadatthuṃ māṇavakānaṃ yeva sutvā samaṇaṃ mahākaccānaṃ akkoseyyaṃ virujjheyyaṃ paribhāseyyaṃ
sn35.132:9.1: atha kho lohicco brāhmaṇo tehi māṇavakehi saddhiṃ yenāyasmā mahākaccāno tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā mahākaccānena saddhiṃ sammodi
sn35.132:9.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho lohicco brāhmaṇo āyasmantaṃ mahākaccānaṃ etadavoca
sn35.132:9.3: āgamaṃsu nu khvidha bho kaccāna amhākaṃ sambahulā antevāsikā kaṭṭhahārakā māṇavakāti.
sn35.132:9.4: āgamaṃsu khvidha te brāhmaṇa sambahulā antevāsikā kaṭṭhahārakā māṇavakāti.
sn35.132:9.5: ahu pana bhoto kaccānassa tehi māṇavakehi saddhiṃ koci deva kathāsallāpoti.
sn35.132:9.6: ahu kho me brāhmaṇa tehi māṇavakehi saddhiṃ ahosi kathāsallāpoti.
sn35.132:9.7: yathā kathaṃ pana bhoto kaccānassa tehi māṇavakehi saddhiṃ ahosi kathāsallāpoti.
sn35.132:9.8: evaṃ kho me brāhmaṇa tehi māṇavakehi saddhiṃ ahosi kathāsallāpoti.
sn35.132:11.1: evaṃ kho me brāhmaṇa tehi saddhiṃ ahosi kathāsallāpoti.
sn35.132:12.2: kittāvatā nu kho bho kaccāna aguttadvāro hotīti.
sn35.132:12.3: idha brāhmaṇa ekacco cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā piyarūpe rūpe adhimuccati appiyarūpe rūpe byāpajjati anupaṭṭhitāya satiyāva viharati parittacetaso
sn35.132:12.4: tañca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti yathāssa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti.
sn35.132:12.9: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya piyarūpe dhamme adhimuccati appiyarūpe dhamme byāpajjati anupaṭṭhitāya satiyāva viharati parittacetaso
sn35.132:12.10: tañca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti. yathāssa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā na nirujjhanti.
sn35.132:12.12: acchariyaṃ bho kaccāna abbhūtaṃ bho kaccāna
sn35.132:12.13: yāvañcidaṃ bhotā kaccānena aguttadvārova samāno aguttadvāroti akkhāto.
sn35.132:13.2: kittāvatā nu kho bho kaccāna guttadvāro hotīti.
sn35.132:13.3: idha brāhmaṇa bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā piyarūpe rūpe nādhimuccati appiyarūpe rūpe na byāpajjati upaṭṭhitāya satiyāva viharati appamāṇacetaso
sn35.132:13.4: tañca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. yathāssa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti.
sn35.132:13.9: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya piyarūpe dhamme nādhimuccati appiyarūpe dhamme na byāpajjati upaṭṭhitāya satiyāva viharati appamāṇacetaso
sn35.132:13.10: tañca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. yathāssa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti.
sn35.132:14.1: acchariyaṃ bho kaccāna abbhūtaṃ bho kaccāna
sn35.132:14.2: yāvañcidaṃ bhotā kaccānena guttadvārova samāno guttadvāroti akkhāto.
sn35.132:14.3: abhikkantaṃ bho kaccāna abhikkantaṃ ko kaccāna
sn35.132:14.4: seyyathāpi bho kaccāna nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya andhakāre vā telappajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantīti. evamevaṃ bho kaccānena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
sn35.132:14.5: esāhaṃ bho kaccāna taṃ bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca
sn35.132:14.6: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ kaccāno dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṅgataṃ.
sn35.132:14.7: yathā ca bhavaṃ kaccāno makkarakaṭe upāsakakulāni upasaṅkamati evamevaṃ lohiccakulaṃ upasaṅkamatu.
sn35.132:14.8: tattha ye māṇavakā māṇavikā vā bhavantaṃ kaccānaṃ abhivādessanti paccupaṭṭhissanti āharissanti āsanaṃ vā udakaṃ vā dassanti tesantaṃ bhavissati dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti.
